summary: Obsidian Energy filed a Form 6-K announcing an increase in its syndicated credit facility to $275 million from $235 million. The revolving period and maturity remain unchanged at May 31, 2027 and May 31, 2028, respectively. The filing references a previously announced Belly River acquisition expected to close on or about June 30, 2026 but provides no new terms, price, premium, or structural details of that deal. This is a routine financing update without a standalone special-situation event; the acquisition itself was disclosed earlier and is not the subject of this filing.
